title: Epic Party
summary: the 24 returning players are divided into three tribes — cila, kalo, and vatu. ozzy wins exile for vatu but is sent to exile island. at tribal council, jenna is voted out 7-1 in the season's first blindside.
scoreImpact: no score impact — jenna was not drafted by any team.

title: Therapy Carousel
summary: kyle suffers an injury and is evacuated from the game on day 4. christian finds the billie eilish boomerang idol on cila beach and sends it to aubry on vatu. cirie picks up an extra vote on the journey. colby loses his vote on the journey. at tribal council, savannah is voted out 6-1.

scoreImpact: mom picks up 3 pts (savannah, 22nd place). christian's idol find earns +1 for annie, sameh, lil, and mom. benson has savannah as an alternate — no swap benefit yet.

title: Did You Vote For a Swap?
summary: a tribe swap shakes up the game. genevieve sends her boomerang idol to ozzy on the new vatu. rick claims to have found an idol to build trust, though it was actually christian's find. at tribal council, q is voted out 5-1.

events.description: found a boomerang idol, sent to ozzy

scoreImpact: big episode — ellie, lil, and dad each pick up 4 pts (q, 21st place). genevieve's idol find earns +1 for ellie, benson, and lil.
